pos: Overgrown living vegetation on a specific private property: tall grass, weeds, hedges encroaching or blocking yard, sidewalk, mailbox, or that property's driveway/frontage.
Ongoing yard or lot maintenance neglect at a residence or business (unmowed lawn, unmaintained landscaping, recurring overgrowth complaints).
Accumulated trash/junk blighting a property's grounds or around structures, including overflowing private dumpsters, with no curbside set-out, sticker, cart-size, or missed-pickup context.
Vegetation from a specific address obstructs egress from its driveway/frontage or grows over wall/fence/sidewalk; not at a public intersection sight triangle.
Mowed grass clippings left piled or windrowed on that property’s yard (excluding discrete cut limbs/trees).
neg: if visibility obstruction involves a public street intersection or crosswalk sight triangle or corner, classify as Line of Sight instead
if report cites curbside set-out/service cues (tags/stickers, cart size/limits, missed pickup) or 'at curb', classify as Trash instead
if it names discrete removable debris (loose trash bags, shopping carts, furniture/appliances, tires, or cut brush/trees), classify as Trash instead
if the primary concern is a vehicle parked on grass/dirt or creating an unimproved parking area, classify as Parking on Unimproved Surface instead

Requests tied to the recycling stream (recycling, recyclables, blue cart/bin, code 945) that do not seek collection service.
Education-only follow-ups after recycling write-ups: document warnings or outreach without any pickup/drop action.

if the issue is yard waste, compost, leaves, or their set-out/stickers, classify as Yard Waste instead.
